cohort: 6511 nulliparous women with a singleton fetus in cephalic presentation with spontaneous onset of labor at term
finding: Women admitted with ≥ 4 cm cervical dilatation had a significantly higher chance of spontaneous delivery and a lower risk of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Nulliparous women admitted with a cervical dilation of 4 cm or greater had a significantly higher chance of spontaneous delivery.
